stem.en: Bhavisha paid ₹1,000 at the end of every year for 40 years, so she put in ₹40,000 of her own money, and at 65 the account held ₹1,99,635. How much of that ₹1,99,635 was added by the scheme rather than paid in by her?

explanation.en: ₹1,59,635. Take what she paid in away from what the account holds: ₹1,99,635 − ₹40,000 = ₹1,59,635. Four times her own deposits came from the scheme, and most of that arrived in the last years, because each year's 7% acts on a balance that has been growing since she was 25.

hints.en: The account holds her deposits plus what the scheme added. You know both the total and the deposits.
